task: Add due date for todo items

history.note: Q1: --due flag optional on add, YYYY-MM-DD format — confirmed
Q2: exact-match --due filter plus separate --overdue flag — confirmed
Q3: show due date in list/filter output (text + JSON), no sort-order change — confirmed
Q4: due-date editing via todo update — out of scope for this issue
Q5: reject invalid --due values with an error; allow past dates — confirmed

human_feedback.question: Should --due <date> be an optional flag on todo add, using YYYY-MM-DD?
human_feedback.answer: Yes, optional flag with YYYY-MM-DD format

human_feedback.question: Should todo filter --due match exact date only, or also have a dedicated --overdue flag?
human_feedback.answer: Yes, exact match plus a separate --overdue flag

human_feedback.question: Should due date show in list/filter output (text + JSON), and should it change the existing sort order?
human_feedback.answer: Yes, show it in both, don't change sort order

human_feedback.question: Should todo update also support changing/clearing a due date, or is that out of scope?
human_feedback.answer: Yes, keep it out of scope for now

human_feedback.question: What should happen on a malformed/invalid --due value, and should past dates be allowed?
human_feedback.answer: Yes, reject invalid dates and allow past dates
